title: Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.5: perf profiles, metadata fields, and changelog automation
author: Maya Rodriguez
body:
Summary: This PR onboards aurora-spark-13b v1.5 into the model registry with updated metadata, performance profiles tuned for dedicated inference, and automation to generate release notes and changelog entries from the model metadata and perf runs. Motivation: customers using aurora-spark reported inconsistent latency at longer sequence lengths after a recent runtime kernel change; while the model itself is unchanged, we need an updated performance profile and explicit metadata (supported quantizations, KV-cache behavior, recommended batch/seq settings) so routing and autoscaling can make correct choices. Additionally, we automated the changelog generation for model releases so release notes always include the canonical perf summary and any known limitations.

What I changed (high level):
- Added model metadata JSON for aurora-spark-13b v1.5, including schema v2 keys (quantizations, recommended_batching, memory_estimates, compatibility_tags).
- Added two new performance profiles (dedicated-low-latency, dedicated-high-throughput) with measured p50/p95/p99 latencies and token/sec numbers from our perf lab. Profiles include sequence-length buckets and cold/warm KV cache estimates.
- Implemented changelog automation script (tools/registry/generate_model_changelog.py) that pulls metadata + perf snapshot and formats the release notes into our changelog/ directory and also creates a JSON artifact consumed by the Console.
- Updated registry CI (ci/model-registry.yml) to run the new perf-profile schema validator and to upload perf snapshots to the artifacts bucket so changelog automation has stable inputs.
- Small test additions: schema unit tests and an end-to-end smoke test that validates changelog generation for a sample model.

Why this is safe: The changes are additive (new model entry and new tools). Schema v2 is backward compatible; the validator flags mismatches but does not block older entries. The runtime behavior is not modified by this PR.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add metadata file and perf profiles
- [x] Add changelog generator and tests
- [x] Update CI to include new checks
- [x] Update docs reference (docs/models/aurora-spark-13b.md) with short summary (non-functional)

Testing: Perf numbers were collected in perf-lab/job-2026-02-12 using the standard harness (seeded prompts, 512/1024 seq buckets). Unit tests pass locally and in CI. Manual smoke-run of changelog generator against artifacts produced the expected markdown and Console JSON.

Rollout notes: This is an immediate add to the model catalog; no rollout coordination required. Console will pick up new release notes via the artifact consumer job (scheduled).

Related: ENG-4080 (serving kernel adjustments for long-seq), SUP-743 (customer case referencing latency).

review_comments: Anya Li: Can you include the exact hardware/instance tags used for the perf runs so we can reproduce? Added a request to metadata.json.
Maya Rodriguez: Added hw_tags and perf_snapshot_id fields to metadata; snapshot id references perf-lab/job-2026-02-12.
Ethan Brooks: Schema v2 looks good; please add one more unit test for seq=2048 boundary.
Maya Rodriguez: Added test for seq=2048 and a guard in generator to cap very large seqs (tooling limitation noted).
Marco D'Souza: CI lint flaked once; re-ran and all green. Approved after one nit about logging level in generator.
Anya Li: Approve (requested hw tags were added and tests cover the boundary conditions).
merge_info: Merged by squash on 2026-02-24 by Marco D'Souza. Commit message: 'Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.5: perf profiles + metadata + changelog automation'
release_notes:
- Onboarded aurora-spark-13b v1.5 with dedicated-performance profiles (low-latency and high-throughput).
- Added metadata fields for quantization support, memory estimates, and hardware tags.
- Introduced changelog automation to generate model release notes from metadata and perf snapshots.
notes_for_operators: Console consumers: the changelog artifact producer writes to s3://redwood-model-changelogs/aurora-spark-13b/v1.5/<timestamp>.json. Make sure the artifact-consumer job has permission to read new prefix. If you see missing perf numbers, confirm perf-lab/job-2026-02-12 artifacts exist.
regression_risks: Low. Changes are additive and covered by unit tests. The only non-additive change was a validator strictness increase in CI which previously allowed a null memory_estimates; we added a guard and tests to avoid blocking existing models.
